meta_description: Taylor Wade Painters & Decorators in Nottingham. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating. Free quotes, fully insured. Call 07944 141412.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert interior and exterior painting. Free quotes, no mess, finished on time.
services_subhead: From interior feature walls to full house repaints, we handle every job with care and attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: We refresh living rooms, bedrooms, and kitchens with high-quality paint and wallpaper. Each room is prepared properly and finished to a professional standard.

services.title: Exterior House Painting
services.desc: Protect and refresh your property's exterior with weather-resistant finishes. We paint fascias, soffits, doors, and walls using products built to last in the Midlands climate.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Design
services.desc: Create a feature wall or complete room transformation with patterned or textured wallpaper. We measure, hang, and trim with precision for a seamless finish.

services.title: Woodwork & Doors
services.desc: Cabinet doors, skirting boards, and internal woodwork benefit from a fresh coat. We sand, prime, and paint to bring old wood back to life.

services.title: Ceiling Decoration
services.desc: High or vaulted ceilings require skill and the right equipment. We paint and repair ceilings safely, leaving no drips or marks on your walls.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Offices and retail spaces need reliable, discreet work. We schedule around your business hours and deliver a professional finish on time.

about_pullquote: We do the job right first time, so you're not paying twice.
about_para_1: Taylor Wade Painters & Decorators has been serving Nottingham and the surrounding areas for over 12 years. We started because we were frustrated with decorators who cut corners and left mess behind. From our base in Hucknall, we've built a reputation for honest pricing, thorough preparation, and finishes that last.
about_para_2: We take pride in the detail work — moving furniture carefully, protecting your floors, and leaving your home spotless. Our customers return because we listen to what they want, turn up when we say we will, and stand behind every job with a guarantee.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Taylor came round to quote for our hallway and lounge. Really professional and gave us a fair price. Did a brilliant job—didn't rush it, took care of everything, and the place looked spotless when he'd finished. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: We had our whole downstairs done—three rooms plus the hallway. Taylor and his team were punctual, worked tidily, and the paint job is flawless. Very happy with the result and the price was reasonable. Will definitely call them again.
reviews.author: Susan K.

reviews.text: Excellent decorators. They repainted our bedroom and wallpapered the feature wall. Really attention to detail, moved our furniture carefully, and didn't leave any mess. Exactly what they quoted for. Top service.
reviews.author: David M.
